violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Replace lid to bucket of au jus in walk in cooler.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Store boxes of food items off floor in walk in freezer.

General premises. — --Opening to outside or portion of building that is not part of the food establishment, was not protected against the entry of insects and rodents. West and North entry doors are not provided with self closing mechanism.
